reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is a code-review user interface: it adds a session-scoped panel for viewing repo diffs and preparing inline review comments. Evidence shows it is intentionally read-only, focused on displaying tracked diffs and composing comments, with bounded git execution settings that keep behavior within local review scope rather than repository mutation.

summaries.zh: dsh-git 是一个会话级 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在会话面板中展示当前仓库相对 HEAD 的工作区差异，并支持按行选择和编辑内嵌评审备注。
summaries.en: dsh-git is a session-scoped DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows working-tree diffs versus HEAD in a review panel and lets users select lines to add inline review comments.

capabilities: Displays tracked working-tree diffs against HEAD in an in-session review panel
Lists untracked paths and renders diff content in unified/split views
Supports selecting line ranges and adding inline review comments
Attaches pending review comments to the normal chat composer payload on submission
Executes local git reads with configurable request/patch/file size limits and subprocess timeout

reasons.code: The README describes a session-scoped Review panel in dsh-dock showing repository working-tree diffs versus HEAD with inline commenting.
The plugin is explicitly documented as read-only and states it does not stage, apply, commit, reset, switch branches, or integrate with forge workflows.
Package manifest marks it as a dsh web plugin with bundle/patch and client injection entries, indicating UI panel integration in the DSH frontend.
Repository includes Cordis patch and client assets consistent with panel registration and browser-side behavior.
